text: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti . [164] kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti . idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti .pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti . ekadhammapeyyālo niṭṭhito . tassuddānaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ sīlaṃ ca chando ca attasampadā diṭṭhi ca appamādo
